tools.name: capture_game_window
tools.description: Captures the current Minecraft game window as a 480p JPEG screenshot and returns base64-encoded image data. This is a relatively expensive visual inspection tool and can distract from code/log based debugging. For UI structure, layout, node visibility, or JSON UI validation, prefer the specialized jsonui_debugger tool before using screenshots. Prefer get_latest_logs, get_latest_error_logs, and deterministic file/code checks first; use screenshots only when the task explicitly requires visual confirmation or logs cannot answer the question.

tools.name: execute_code
tools.description:
Executes provided code in the game environment.
Parameters:
- code: The code to Py2 execute. Expression code returns the expression value; statement code may assign _result to define the returned value.
- is_client: Whether to execute on client side (true) or server side (false)
- direct_return: Whether to wait for and directly return the execution result (default true). Set false to use the legacy async log-based behavior.

direct_return.description: Directly return execution result instead of relying on logs? Default true.

tools.name: get_latest_error_logs
tools.description:
Returns stderr error log entries only. May not include all errors (e.g., JSON parsing errors). Use get_latest_logs for complete logs.

Parameters:
- max_count: Maximum number of log entries to return
- order: "asc" for oldest to newest, "desc" for newest to oldest

max_count.description: Maximum number of log entries to return

tools.name: get_latest_logs
tools.description:
Returns the most recent game log entries.

Parameters:
- max_count: Maximum number of log entries to return
- order: "asc" for oldest to newest
         "desc" for newest to oldest

max_count.description: Maximum number of log entries to return

tools.name: get_log_range
tools.description:
Returns a specific range of recent game log entries by index.

Logs are indexed relative to the most recent entry:
- index 0 refers to the newest log
- index 1 refers to the second newest log
- and so on

Parameters:
- start_index: Starting index (inclusive)
- end_index: Ending index (exclusive)
- order: "asc" for oldest to newest
         "desc" for newest to oldest

tools.name: jsonui_debugger
tools.description: Analyze native Minecraft JSON UI runtime state through a command string. Pass the command in the cmd argument; use cmd="/help" to list available commands and usage. Supports screen listing, node lookup, shallow tree inspection, layout snapshots, and HTML-like pseudo output derived from Minecraft runtime layout/render data for layout reference only. Read-only by default with depth/node limits to avoid large UI dumps.

cmd.description: Command string. Use /help to list commands and usage.

tools.name: mc_input
tools.description: Drives the Minecraft game window through keyboard and mouse input. One call can run a whole ordered sequence: clicks, long presses, drags, wheel, camera motion, text and waits. Use capture='end' and logs='end' to attach a screenshot and recent logs. Call /help first; /state reports window geometry and whether the game currently holds the pointer. Coordinates default to the 0.0-1.0 percentage space shared with capture_game_window. A successful result means input was dispatched to the system queue, not that the game reacted - verify with capture_game_window or logs. Input uses {op:'/...', args:{...}}.

tools.name: mc_profiler
tools.description: Profiles Minecraft Python CPU, Python memory, and optional Native CPU through one bounded command tool. Native profiles can correlate instrumented Python-facing and engine C++ Tracy zone hierarchies, including lower-level stages such as data-driven JSON parsing when those zones are emitted. Call /help first. Every capture has a server deadline; temporary memory results expire after 20 idle minutes, and Markdown/SVG reports are explicit exports. Results are filtered and paged; same-kind captures support bounded server-side comparison. Input uses {op:'/...', args:{...}}.

tools.name: reload_game
tools.description:
Reloads the running game environment. Prefer automatic Python/UI/Shader/Material hot reload when available; use this only when a full engine-side refresh is still needed.

Parameters:
- reload_addons: When true, trigger the more complete addon-data + game reload path. Use it for resource changes such as JSON, PNG, audio, or other addon files not handled by automatic hot reload.

reload_addons.description: Reload addon data together with the game environment

from modern_projection.pyreact import navigator
owner=api.GetSystem('ModernProjection','ModernProjectionClientSystem')
assert owner is not None and owner.session is not None, 'Workspace is not initialized'
s=owner.session
b=owner.bridge
def native_camera_snapshot():
 cam=b.factory.CreateCamera(b.level)
 return {'position':cam.GetPosition(),'rotation':cam.GetCameraRotation(),'forward':cam.GetForward(),
  'pitch_lock':cam.IsModCameraLockPitch(),'yaw_lock':cam.IsModCameraLockYaw(),
  'motions':cam.GetCameraMotions()}
def native_camera_matches(actual,expected):
 return (all(abs(a-v)<=.01 for a,v in zip(actual['position'],expected['position'])) and
  all(abs((a-v+180.)%360.-180.)<=.01 for a,v in zip(actual['rotation'],expected['rotation'])) and
  all(abs(a-v)<=.0001 for a,v in zip(actual['forward'],expected['forward'])) and
  all(actual[key]==expected[key] for key in ('pitch_lock','yaw_lock','motions')))
from copy import deepcopy
import math
from modern_projection.projection.bridge import _stable_palette
from modern_projection.projection import static_frame_item_data
assert not hasattr(sys,'_item_skeleton_r13_probe')
assert navigator.is_ready and not navigator.is_transitioning
assert not navigator.get_entries(), 'World view requires no pre-existing pages'
assert not s.busy and not s.projection_active and not b.preparing_entity
assert not any(profile['accepted'] for profile in static_frame_item_data.FRAME_ITEMS.values())
player=api.GetLocalPlayerId()
assert player and player!='-1'
foot=b.factory.CreatePos(player).GetFootPos()
assert foot is not None and len(foot)==3 and all(not math.isnan(value) and not math.isinf(value) for value in foot),foot
assert -1024.<foot[1]<4096.,('Player level is not physically loaded',foot)
screen=b.factory.CreateGame(b.level).GetScreenSize()
assert len(screen)==2 and all(value>32 for value in screen),screen
saved={'nonce':'7f41d6c1d369445a818c94af4a6e6e94','key':'client_anchor_depth_'+'7f41d6c1d369445a818c94af4a6e6e94','player':player,'foot':foot,
 'navigation':[entry.key for entry in navigator.get_entries()],
 'document':deepcopy(s.editor.document.to_data()),
 'profiles':repr(_stable_palette(static_frame_item_data.FRAME_ITEMS)),
 'camera':deepcopy(dict((key,getattr(s,key)) for key in ('camera_pose','camera_pivot','camera_pan','camera_depth_pose'))),
 'plain':json.loads('{"isEnchanted": false, "newAuxValue": 0, "newItemName": "minecraft:diamond_sword", "userData": {}}'),'actor':None,'create':{'state':'pending','attempted':True},
 'journal':[],'attachments':[],'current':None,'body':None,'control':'world_empty',
 'push_attempted':False,'declared_size':min(240.,screen[0]-32.,screen[1]-32.),
 'size_inputs':screen,'markers':(('native_item_marker_tl', [0, 255, 255]), ('native_item_marker_tr', [255, 0, 255]), ('native_item_marker_bl', [255, 255, 0]), ('native_item_marker_br', [0, 255, 0])),'ui_params':{'scale': 0.35, 'render_depth': -15, 'init_rot_x': 0.0, 'init_rot_y': 0.0, 'init_rot_z': 0.0}}
cam_before=native_camera_snapshot()
assert not cam_before['motions'],('Camera has active motions',cam_before)
for key in ('position','rotation','forward'):
 values=cam_before[key]
 assert values is not None and len(values)==3 and all(not math.isnan(v) and not math.isinf(v) for v in values),(key,values)
forward=cam_before['forward']
length=math.sqrt(sum(v*v for v in forward))
assert length>.000001,('Camera forward is invalid',forward)
position=tuple(cam_before['position'][i]+forward[i]*3./length for i in range(3))
assert -1024.<position[1]<4096.,('Anchor placement is outside loaded height',position)
block=b.factory.CreateBlockInfo(b.level)
empty_cells=[]
for x in range(int(math.floor(position[0]-1.)),int(math.floor(position[0]+1.))+1):
 for y in range(int(math.floor(position[1]-1.)),int(math.floor(position[1]+1.))+1):
  for z in range(int(math.floor(position[2]-1.)),int(math.floor(position[2]+1.))+1):
   cell=(x,y,z)
   value=block.GetBlock(cell)
   assert value is not None and len(value)==2 and value[0]=='minecraft:air',('Placement is not verified loaded air',cell,value)
   empty_cells.append({'position':cell,'block':value})
saved['native_camera']=cam_before
saved['position']=position
saved['empty_cells']=empty_cells
saved['roi_receipt']={'physical_size':[1994,1105],'world':[0,111,1994,1105],'ui':[0,111,1994,1105],
 'declared_before_capture':True,'basis':'fixed native capture extent; top debug band excluded; anchor at camera forward ray distance 3; UI centered declared bounds'}

sys._item_skeleton_r13_probe=saved
candidate=b.system.CreateClientEntityByTypeStr('modern_projection:anchor',saved['position'],(0.,0.))
saved['create']['value']=candidate
saved['create']['state']='returned'
if candidate is not None and candidate!='':
 saved['create']['state']='invalid_return'
 assert isinstance(candidate,basestring) and candidate not in ('-1',player),saved['create']
 saved['actor']=candidate
 saved['create']['state']='returned'
assert saved['actor'] is not None,saved['create']
saved['ui_params']['entity_id']=saved['actor']
saved['skeleton_setup']={'model':'modern_projection_diagnostic_item_body_r13','state':'pending'}
saved['skeleton_setup']['model_id']=b.factory.CreateModel(saved['actor']).SetModel('modern_projection_diagnostic_item_body_r13')
saved['skeleton_setup']['state']='returned'
identity=saved['skeleton_setup']['model_id']
assert isinstance(identity,(int,long)) and not isinstance(identity,bool) and identity>=0,saved['skeleton_setup']
_result=json.dumps(dict((key,saved[key]) for key in ('nonce','key','player','foot','position','actor','create','navigation','document','profiles','camera','declared_size','size_inputs','ui_params','native_camera','empty_cells','roi_receipt','skeleton_setup')))
